newsitem.title: UK: UK Commercial law firms enjoy boom-report.
newsitem.headline: UK Commercial law firms enjoy boom-report.

text.p: British commercial law firms are enjoying an 1980's style boom, with the top 100 firms billing 3.25 billion pounds in fees in 1995-1996, Legal Business Magazine said.
This is an increase of 250 million pounds over the previous financial year and 500 million pounds more than in 1992-1993, it said.
The survey, cited by the Financial Times, showed that Slaughter and May was the most profitable firm. It had average profits of 460,000 pounds per partner, up from 395,000 pounds in 1994-1995.
